lines.en: I hang beneath the leaf.
I cannot take a single step.
The wind keeps pushing the leaf.
My silk is pulled taut.
The wind on the plain comes in gusts.
Something stirs inside the shell.
I swing slowly round.
My colour is like a dead leaf.
I hide by the leaf stem.
I dare not loosen my grip.
The sun has softened the leaf.
I am two blocks above the ground.
I hang close to the vein.
Raindrops strike one by one.
I can hold on. It is just unpleasant.
I wait to become a heath butterfly.
I hang, perfectly still.
Nothing changes outside.

lines.zh: 我知道自己会变成什么。
lines.en: I know what I will become.
Wings press against me from inside.
The leaf sways gently.
I count the daylight.
The wind passes between the leaves.
Inside the shell, only my heartbeat sounds.
The time is nearly here.
I can feel wings now.
Something crawls over the outside.
Best to stay still.
I drew the silk a little tighter.
Look up.
Are you picking this leaf?
I cannot move out of the way.
See how I match the leaf.
You cannot reach me.
I know this plain.
What is that in your hand.
I cannot turn my body.
Touch the tree and I sway.
I am swinging wildly.
There is a crack in my shell.
The silk is creaking.
Only a thread still holds me.
No sound will come out of me.
Something shifted inside.
The silk bites into the vein; I hold.
That should not have happened.

lines.zh: 震了一下，我在壳里稳住。
lines.en: One jolt, and I steady myself inside.
At least I have not fallen yet.
I do not feed at this stage.
At this stage I only wait.
Holding it higher will not help.
I taste nothing inside the shell.
The leaf is my bed.
Do not place it beneath me.
I have no need of those.
Put it in your bag.
I am nearly ready to emerge.
I only wait for that moment.
The bump set me spinning.
The silk pulled tighter.
I am flipped over, then back.
My silk scraped against the stalk.
My shell clicked against the leaf.
I tilt, and the silk pulls me straight again.
That was close.
Do not touch the stem.
I swung back.
Keep farther off.
I am still sealed in the shell.
This is not the time.
Wait until the wings harden.

lines.zh: 同一片叶子下面还有别人。
lines.en: There are others under the same leaf.
Those beside me are sealed up too.
Each hangs on its own leaf.
The real start is the day I emerge.
Not before I have wings.
Almost there.
A few more days.
I cannot even reach it.
I cannot even reach the stalk.
That fell.
I cannot use this.
It is too far from me.
I cannot even move my head.
I cannot even lift it.
Do not put it under the leaf.
The silk holds me fast.
Leave it for someone else.
Something stirs under the leaf.
I rock a little and play dead leaf.
That shadow falls on the leaf.
I shorten the silk and press to the leaf.
I hold everything still.
It might not see me.
My shape shows on the leaf.
Endure a little more.

lines.zh: 但愿它抬头也看不见我。
lines.en: I hope it looks up and sees nothing.
All I can do is let the leaf hide me.
The movement is still there.
The stem is trembling.
I pull the silk a little shorter.
It circled once beneath me.
I press against the leaf.
No breathing. No moving.
It looked up.
Its scent is still close.
Endure a short while more.
It seems to have gone.
I have no way to attack.
My shell is thin; it stops nothing.
I cannot even sway.
This hardly counts as a counter.
Hitting me hurts you too.
Gently, do not shake the tree.
I will still hang here.
Give it up.
I am nearly ready. Do not disturb me.
I have no way at all to fight back.

lines.zh: 一枚小环蝶蛹悬在叶下。
lines.en: A heath chrysalis hangs beneath the leaf.
I became this from a caterpillar.
The silk is still new.
This plain suits me.
The leaf hides half of me.
I go quiet in the tree's shade.
A thin sheen lies on my shell.
Soon. Almost ready.
I am hanging firmly.
You cannot tell I am alive.
The leaf is burning, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我从丝上脱了，直坠下去。
lines.en: The silk gave and I plummeted.
Water fills the shell and I cannot breathe.
The whole leaf was blown off.
Something pierced the shell.
This force came through.
I do not eat, but I cannot last either.
The thunder was right at my ear.
There is no leaf here.
